ref_text: طيب أخوي، نقدر نسوي لك استرجاع جزء من المبلغ، مثلاً خمسين ريال، وبنضيف لك خصم مية وتسعة وتسعين ريال على الطلب الجاي، موافق؟

notes: Nasser AlJubaily, Najdi male support agent: one of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (8,012 of his clips, 11.0 h, all Najdi), and its house voice: cloned unless the request names another. An agent offering a refund and a discount, said cheerfully. A longer clip than the 5.8 s greeting used until 2026-10-05, chosen by ear from the audition page of that day. Of his 11 held-out agent lines of 9.5-18 s spoken warmly or calmly, the four nearest his own pace were each cloned on six sentences (four short, two long) with the shipped model: this one measures level with the short clip (similarity -0.004, UTMOS +0.06, both within noise) and gave the lowest error rate of the four. Its clones run a little slower than he does (0.94x).
